$comment: Proxy-only Vercel project. This keeps the legacy iptvbridge.vercel.app domain (already installed by thousands of users) working by CDN-rewriting every request to the Cloudflare Worker. No serverless function is invoked. Replace <ACCOUNT-SUBDOMAIN> with your Cloudflare account's workers.dev subdomain (the Worker is named 'iptvbridge'), or with a custom domain bound to the Worker.
